# LOG-4: Logging costs bandwidth, and a change says how much it adds

- Log bandwidth and card space do not grow. A change that adds or enlarges messages states the increase, and logs only what is in use: nothing for cores or lanes that are not running the feature.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Logging and GCS Messages](../claude/CLAUDE.md#logging-and-gcs-messages). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
